about: What HostLab's own surface path (the frozen native_surface.scan, native_cli.CliSession and audit_common) answers on the reference engine for the synthetic APKs of tests/fixtures/surface; generated by integrations/hostlab/surface_make_goldens.py, checked offline with --check.

declared_differences.new: such a class is fingerprinted as a class without methods: SHA-256 of nothing, no Composer signatures
declared_differences.original: native_surface.scan completes but never sets method_bodies_sha256 and compose_signatures for those classes; surface_workers.summarize then raises KeyError
declared_differences.reason: a crash that depends on which DEX file a class is in is not a behaviour worth keeping; the defined value is the one the original gives to a method-less class in a DEX file that does have methods
declared_differences.title: a family class in a DEX file in which no family class has a method

declared_differences.new: every relation read (classes, class_fields, class_methods, method_calls, code_items) selects file_id and refuses a row of another file (SourceMismatch); the archive bytes are bound to the engine's recorded header fields (length, version, checksum, signature) before any offset is used
declared_differences.original: the scan reads each relation with `WHERE file_id=...` but never re-checks the file_id of the rows it gets back, and code_items is selected without its file_id at all; the archive bytes are used without comparing them to the engine's facts
declared_differences.reason: a local id is only meaningful with the source it came from. The binding compares the header fields the engine recorded; it does not recompute adler32 or SHA-1 over the body. Whole-file identity is the APK SHA-256 checked before and after the run, and the ZIP reader checks each member's CRC
declared_differences.title: rows are checked against the file they were asked for, and bytes against the facts

declared_differences.original: the last one silently replaces the first
declared_differences.reason: a silent replacement binds a body to the wrong method
declared_differences.title: one method_idx naming two methods, or two code rows for one method, in one DEX file

declared_differences.new: admitted only when the stream's terminal line says ok, complete, untruncated and of the opened snapshot
declared_differences.original: the transport reads the rows it is given until the marker
declared_differences.reason: an incomplete answer must never be an empty or shorter result
declared_differences.title: partial, truncated or errored engine answers

declared_differences.new: the same condition as a balanced tree of the same predicates (the dynamic-page test distributed over its three words); the provider refuses more than 64 OR terms, or a statement whose parentheses nest more than 9 deep (SurfaceError), before sending it
declared_differences.reason: the debug build of the engine aborts the process with a stack overflow on a chain of 20 terms, or on a condition nested about ten deep (nine levels are answered, ten are not); the cap keeps every statement sent within what the engine admits
declared_differences.title: the SQL of the family filter

declared_differences.reason: the report says which engine did the work; it is not part of the report digest
declared_differences.title: scan_execution

declared_differences.new: refused (SourceMismatch) before any of its bytes are used
declared_differences.original: zipfile.getinfo keeps the last member of a name; the scan reads it without noticing the earlier one
declared_differences.reason: physical occurrences are not deduplicated: which member's bytes the facts describe cannot be decided, so the scan refuses instead of silently choosing the last
declared_differences.title: an archive with two members named like one DEX file of the dataset

declared_differences.new: read_identities refuses both (SourceMismatch) before any fact is read
declared_differences.original: session.files is a dict, so a repeated file_id keeps the last row silently; two equal names fall into the ambiguous-number refusal only after the scan has begun
declared_differences.reason: a local id and a member name must each name exactly one source; the archive is read by name, so a shared name cannot be bound to one file's facts
declared_differences.title: a file_id naming two DEX files, or two DEX files sharing one entry name
